source.citation: The Sun and the New York Herald (New York), September 29, 1920, p. 1: 'EIGHT WHITE SOX INDICTED FOR THROWING 1919 SERIES; CICOTTE CONFESSES PLOT'.
what_it_does_not_supply: the verdict: the trial came in 1921, after this issue
what_it_supplies: that eight White Sox players (seven current, one former) were indicted on 28 September 1920 for throwing the 1919 World Series to Cincinnati
that Eddie Cicotte and Joe Jackson confessed to the grand jury
